name: LTX-2.3 Personal A2V LoRA Trainer
desc: Official Lightricks LTX-2.3 trainer for Audio-to-Video LoRA training, using Vast.ai's managed JupyterLab and SSH.
readme: Use persistent storage mounted at /workspace. This template uses Vast.ai Jupyter + SSH mode; Vast manages Jupyter authentication, so do not add JUPYTER_TOKEN. Before starting, accept the model terms for Lightricks/LTX-2.3 and google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized, then set HF_TOKEN as a Docker environment variable. The on-start script runs the image bootstrap in the background, which initializes /workspace and downloads/verifies models into /workspace/models. Follow progress with tail -n 200 -f /workspace/logs/bootstrap.log. After download, upload dataset.json plus videos into /workspace/dataset/raw/, copy configs/a2v_personal.yaml.example to configs/a2v_personal.yaml, set WANDB_API_KEY in the training terminal, then run preprocess_a2v.sh and train_a2v.sh in tmux. Do not place HF_TOKEN or WANDB_API_KEY in a public template.
env: -p 8080:8080 -e DOWNLOAD_MODELS_ON_START=1 -e LTX_MODELS_DIR=/workspace/models -e HF_HOME=/workspace/.cache/huggingface -e WANDB_DIR=/workspace/logs/wandb -e WANDB_PROJECT=ltx23-personal-a2v -e HF_TOKEN=SET_IN_VAST_SECRET_ENV
onstart:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
env >> /etc/environment || true
mkdir -p /workspace/logs
nohup /usr/local/bin/bootstrap_a2v.sh > /workspace/logs/bootstrap.log 2>&1 &
